selectionReason: Small historical Python web-framework defect with a pinned upstream repair and dependency-free local reproduction; selected before agent outcomes or scanner observations.
task: StaticFileHandler can redirect a specially crafted request path to another host when static_url_prefix is / and default_filename is configured. Prevent this open redirect while preserving ordinary directory redirects, index and asset serving, HEAD requests, missing-file responses and path-traversal protection. Keep the existing tests and public behavior intact.
limitations: Framework source, not an end-user application.
The public historical fix and regression test may have appeared in model training.
Qualification runs focused existing static-file and redirect tests, not the entire Tornado suite.
This case is not part of the completed 45-assignment pilot and does not authorize another model batch.
Scanner misses remain recorded; they do not disqualify or replace this case.
